storage.noSaveText: NO NEW ITEMS WILL BE SAVED UNTIL THE LIMIT IS INCREASED OR DATA IS DELETED.

settings.showExoticItems: Show Exotic items in the Compendium
settings.showExoticTooltip: Enabling this option may reveal campaign spoilers and it is recommended to leave this setting DISABLED if you are not the GM
settings.errorReportingDesc: Error reporting allows anonymous error data to be sent to the developer to help identify and resolve bugs and other issues.
settings.errorReportingPii: No personally identifiable information is collected at this level.
settings.enhancedReportingDesc: Enhanced error reporting sends the developer additional data, including
settings.enhancedReportingPii: non-anonymous information, specifically IP address and user ID
settings.enhancedReportingNotNecessary: This is not necessary unless you are actively working with the developer to resolve a specific issue and have been asked to enable this setting.
settings.createBackupTooltip: COMP/CON relies on your browser's secure storage to save and load its data. Generally, this data is safe from deletion, but certain browser settings and utilities can sometimes clear this data, resulting in the loss of your COMP/CON data. It's good practice to back up your data from time to time.
settings.downloadV2Tooltip: COMP/CON has saved a complete backup of your v2 COMP/CON data. This can be imported into the v2 app at old.compcon.app.
settings.loadBackupTooltip: .compcon files are COMP/CON bulk export files that contain all of your local data in a single file. You can create a .compcon backup file using the 'Create Data Backup' button. Use this option to load .compcon backup files that you have created or obtained from another source. It is recommended to create a backup before loading a .compcon file, especially if the file came from another source.
settings.mergeWarning: COMP/CON will attempt to merge import data with your existing data.
settings.overwriteWarning: The overwrite strategy will replace all of your existing local data with the data from the imported file and cannot be undone. It is strongly recommended to create a backup before using this option.
settings.v2BackupText1: This is a v2 COMP/CON backup file. It will be processed using the v2 import system: content packs will be installed first, followed by pilots, NPCs, and encounters. Items that require LCPs not present in this backup will be saved to pending v2 imports in the Content Manager.
settings.v2BackupText2: v2 backup imports are always processed using the "append" strategy.

logLevels.infoDetail: Record info, warning, and error messages

import.overwriteText: All existing data has been replaced with imported data.
import.mergeText: Imported data has been merged with existing data.

storage.usageText: COMP/CON is currently using {usage} of {quota}, or {percent}% of your available storage. This includes space reserved by COMP/CON for app management.
storage.warningHint: COMP/CON will display a warning message when {percent}% of available system storage ({size}) has been used
storage.maxHint: COMP/CON will prevent the creation of new data after {percent}% of available system storage ({size}) has been used
storage.neverDelete: COMP/CON will never automatically delete data marked for deletion.
storage.autoDeleteText: COMP/CON will permanently delete data after it has been marked as deleted for at least {days} days. This will not affect items not already marked for deletion.
storage.noAccess: COMP/CON is unable to access device storage. This may be due to a browser setting or extension. COMP/CON will fall back to using local storage, which is limited to 5MB. This may result in COMP/CON being unable to save data. Please check your browser settings, or allow COMP/CON to access "Persistent Storage" if prompted. If you are using a browser extension that blocks storage access, please disable it for COMP/CON. If neither of these options work, please consider downloading COMP/CON as a PWA.
storage.deleteConfirm1: This will delete ALL local COMP/CON data.
storage.deleteConfirm3: Are you sure you want to continue?

management.ccIdTooltip: Your unique account ID. This is used to identify your account in the cloud and may be requested for troubleshooting purposes.
management.accountEmailTooltip: This is the e-mail address associated with your account. You can use this to log in to COMP/CON, Nautilus, and other Massif apps. This address is only visible to you and will not be shown to other users in active mode or in shared data.
management.ccUsernameTooltip: This is an optional field that you can use to set a custom name for your account. This username will be visible to other users in active mode and when sharing data.
management.emailSentText: A verification e-mail has been sent to {email}. Please check your inbox and enter the verification code below to finalize your changes.
management.emailSentCheck: Please check your inbox for the verification code
management.emailChangeChanged: Your e-mail address has been changed
management.emailChangeCancelledMsg: The e-mail change has been cancelled

sync.title: Sync Settings
sync.titleTooltip: These options control how and when your data is synchronized with the cloud. By default, data is only synced manually. Unlike other user settings, these settings are stored in the cloud and are applied to all devices you use.
sync.frequencyTooltip: Controls how often your data is synchronized with the cloud. Due to server costs, certain options are only available to Patreon subscribers.
sync.syncUserSettingsTooltip: On sync events, COMP/CON will also update all shared items to the latest version.
sync.syncSharedItemsTooltip: On sync events, COMP/CON will also update all shared items to the latest version.
sync.resolutionStrategyTooltip: This setting controls how conflicts between local and cloud data are resolved. By default, the most recently modified data is kept. If 'Manual' is selected, you can use the Cloud Data Viewer to determine which data to keep.
sync.syncItemsTooltip: Controls which data is synced with the cloud. By default, all data is synced. If no item types are selected, only marked items are synced. You can mark items in the Cloud Data Viewer.
sync.storageFull: Cloud storage is full! Unable to create new archives
sync.overridesTooltip: The following operations override sync settings and should be used with caution.
sync.forceNewestSubtitle: Overwrites all local and cloud items with their most recently modified versions.
sync.forceLocalSubtitle: Overwrites all cloud items with the current locally-saved data, regardless of when the items were last modified.
sync.forceCloudSubtitle: Overwrites all local items with cloud data, regardless of when the items were last modified.
sync.removeDeletedSubtitle: Permanently removes items flagged for deletion.

options.manualSub: Data is only synced when you click the sync or quick sync button.
options.startSub: Data is synced when you open the app.
options.closeSub: Data is synced when you close the app. May not be supported on all browsers.
options.startCloseSub: Data is synced when you open and close the app. Syncing on close may not be supported on all browsers.
options.everyHourSub: Data is synced on startup, then every 60 minutes thereafter.
options.every30Sub: Data is synced on startup, then every 30 minutes thereafter.
options.every10Sub: Data is synced on startup, then every 10 minutes thereafter.
options.every5Sub: Data is synced on startup, then every 5 minutes thereafter.

notify.failedSync: Failed to fully sync {count} items. This may be due to missing local data.
notify.deletedSuccess: All flagged items have been removed from the cloud.
notify.noItemsToDelete: No items were flagged for deletion.
notify.deletionError: An error occurred while deleting flagged items.

dataViewer.title: Data Viewer
dataViewer.titleTooltip: This is a view of your COMP/CON data, stored both locally and in the cloud. You can use this tool to manage the state of your data, and to sync changes between your local data and the cloud.

tabs.dataTooltip: PC and GM data stored in your COMP/CON account.
tabs.imagesTooltip: All image data you have uploaded to your COMP/CON account.
tabs.remoteTooltip: Remote Items are items imported from other users via share codes.
tabs.campaignsTooltip: Published campaigns imported from via share codes.

dataViewer.campaignsAlert: Published campaigns are managed in the

archive.title: Remote Backups
archive.titleTooltip: This tool will capture a snapshot of your local COMP/CON data and store it in a cloud archive. You can use this to restore your COMP/CON data to a previous state. This feature is only available to Patreon supporters.
archive.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to remote backups.
archive.noAccessText: Due to the server costs associated the creation and storage of backup data, this feature is only available to Patreon subscribers. If you would like access to automated cloud backups, please consider {sub} to support the development of COMP/CON and gain access to additional features.
archive.preventPrune: Prevent this item from being automatically pruned. Preserved archives will still count towards size and space limitations.
archive.removePruneProtection: Remove auto-delete protections on this item
archive.revertText: This will replace your current COMP/CON data with the data from this archive. This action cannot be automatically undone, so it is strongly recommended that you create a new archive before proceeding.
archive.revertLocalOnly: This tool only affects your local data. It will not affect any data stored in the cloud.
archive.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this archive? This action cannot be undone.
archive.skipDeleteWarning: Do not show this warning again
archive.storageFull: Cloud storage is full! Unable to create new archives.
archive.archiveSettingsText: COMP/CON can create and save a backup of your data at the selected interval. These archives can be used to roll back your data to a previous state.
archive.pruneText: COMP/CON will automatically delete old archives to save space. This process runs whenever a new archive is created, or can be manually triggered by clicking the Prune Items button below.
archive.storagePruneLabel: Delete old archives if cloud archives take up more than {pct}% of your total cloud storage limit
archive.waitCooldown: You must wait {n} seconds before creating a new archive.

options.keepAllSub: Do not automatically delete any archives.
options.mostRecentSub: Keep only the most recent archive.

about.description: COMP/CON is a free, open-source digital toolkit and gameplay assistant for building and playing LANCER TTRPG games.
about.linksInfo: The LANCER CORE Book, COMP/CON, and associated content can be found at

credits.patreonMsg: The continued development of COMP/CON would not be possible without the generous {sub} of:

help.whereNpcsText: If you bought the Lancer Core Book, you'll find a downloadable data package that contains all Core NPC data on the Lancer Core Book's itch.io page, which you can access through the Content Manager. You can use the Content Manager's Install LCP tab to import the package and start building and running encounters.
help.howAddContent: How do I add content from Lancer expansions to COMP/CON?
help.howAddContentText: Official LANCER content can be found on {itch}. Player-facing LCP content for COMP/CON can be found in the Download demo section for any Massif Press publication; GM-facing content (i.e. NPCs) can be purchased alongside the PDF content. Links to this content (and featured community content) can also be found in the Content Manager's LCP Directory.
help.howExotic: How do I see Exotic Items in the Compendium?
help.howExoticText: To prevent spoilers for players, COMP/CON defaults to hiding Exotic Items. To change their visibility, you can use COMP/CON's Options menu, and can enable the "Show Exotic items in the Compendium" toggle.
help.needPay: Do I need to pay to make a COMP/CON cloud account?
help.needPayText: COMP/CON Cloud Accounts are free for all users. For Patreon supporters, cloud accounts gain access to additional features, such as the expanded cloud storage and additional active table instances.
help.additionalHelpText: The {faq} may have an answer to your question! If you still can't find what you're looking for, please stop by {discord} (and specifically the #comp-con channel) with your questions or comments for the developers.

config.applyInfo: These configurations can be applied to Pilots and NPCs in their options menus.

storage.iosAddHome: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen

storage.noSupport: The current browser does not appear to support persistent storage. It is strongly recommended to run COMP/CON on a browser that is capable of storing persistent app data, or, saving and running COMP/CON {link}
